sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु वैदेह्या प्रत्युवाच प्लवङ्गमः ।गृहीतप्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं सीतायाः प्रमुखे स्थितः ।। ६.११६.२२ ।।
transliteration: evamuktastu vaidehyā pratyuvāca plavaṅgamaḥ ।gṛhītaprāñjalirvākyaṁ sītāyāḥ pramukhe sthitaḥ ।। 6.116.22 ।।

translations.english: "You alone can speak such affectionate words in this manner wishing victory and welfare of your dear husband. You are irreproachable."
